scope: Three original representative assets only. No production runtime integration.

conditions.decode: Pillow/libwebp CPU proxy: in-memory encoded bytes, open + load + RGBA conversion + tobytes; 5 warmups, 40 measured repetitions, no I/O in timing; sequential frames.
conditions.decoded_memory: Mathematical RGBA8 pixel budget, not observed resident or GPU memory. Native decoder/driver/DOM caches may retain more or fewer buffers.
conditions.browser_measurement: Not obtained: packaged Playwright browser missing; installed Chromium failed with socket EPERM. Elevated supported retry failed at sandbox setup (read-only sessions path). No bypass attempted.

glb.compressed_transfer_note: Optional transport estimate only; actual host response encoding was not tested.
glb.gpu_and_js_heap: Not measured. Packed geometry is not total GPU/JS memory; renderer, materials, canvas buffers and loader overhead excluded.

camera.fit: Per-asset maximum projected vertex radius over all 16 views; constant zoom per asset.
